title.narrative: Nali¿Themba: Preventing Violence, Expanding Access to Rights and Bringing Hope to Trans and Gender Diverse Communities in South Africa

description.narrative:
The Action responds to the CfP global objective to strengthen capacity of local and national CSOs to engage

in gender equality and youth inclusion targeting CBOs and CSOs of minority groups with a SOGIE (sexual

orientation, gender identity and expression) perspective at provincial and national levels with youth-oriented

actions.

It addresses one of its specific objectives ¿to prevent Gender-Based Violence and femicide in public

and private spheres¿, focusing on GBVF of trans and gender diverse people but also supporting, through multisector

coordination with the LGBTQI+ and women¿s rights movements, multi-sector coordinated strategies to

prevent all forms of GBVF.

The value of 12284 corresponds to 5 contributions to EURF 2.15 814 954 8048 2326 105 In all of them the EURF indicator was encoded as a logframe indicator and there arent comments in OPSYS to clarify to what it corresponds to the justification of the match and any calculations involved. From the narrative of the report is also unclear to know if there is double counting amongst the individuals reported under the different values. It is therefore decided to only report the highest value of all of them 8048 which corresponds to the number of youth registered and successfully completed skill development courses.
